description: Native mobile app packaging: Configure Android release signing, iOS release scheme, proper versioning for both platforms, app store metadata files, and Fastlane-ready directory structure.
steps: Update android/app/build.gradle: add signingConfigs block for release (reading from environment variables or keystore.properties), enable minification with R8 for release builds, set versionCode to 1 and versionName to 1.0.0.
Create android/keystore.properties.example with placeholder values documenting required signing config (storeFile, storePassword, keyAlias, keyPassword).
Create android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml update: ensure app_name is '알비연 링크'.

Create fastlane/metadata/android/ko-KR/ directory structure with: title.txt ('알비연 링크'), short_description.txt, full_description.txt (Korean app store description highlighting ROTC business network features).
Create fastlane/metadata/ios/ko/ directory structure with: name.txt, subtitle.txt, description.txt, keywords.txt, privacy_url.txt (pointing to /privacy in-app route), support_url.txt.
Update ios/App/App/Info.plist: add NSAppTransportSecurity for HTTPS enforcement, ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=NO (no custom encryption), privacy usage descriptions if needed.
Update capacitor.config.ts: add plugins config for SplashScreen (auto-hide delay, fade duration) and StatusBar styling.
Create scripts/build-android.sh documenting the Android release build steps (clean, bundle, sign).
Create scripts/build-ios.sh documenting the iOS archive/export steps.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds (no TypeScript errors from capacitor.config.ts changes)
fastlane/metadata/ directories exist with Korean store listing content
scripts/build-android.sh and scripts/build-ios.sh exist with documented steps
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm success (TypeScript + Vite)
Verify fastlane metadata files exist and contain Korean content
